remaining_limits: No completed authenticated agent task, production credential broker or trusted Remote-SSH qualification
Guest/host wall-clock differences are recorded; test-certificate validity covers both clocks without changing either clock or bypassing TLS
Negative controls are not a security audit; exposed hypervisor/kernel interfaces and retained descriptors remain attack surface
Controller separation and minimal materialization close two experimental gaps; they do not qualify the full product backend or transfer the original 180-case density result to later binaries
The offline network namespace is guest-enforced in a trusted fixed recipe; it does not exclude escape by hostile guest root into the preparation VM network
Fresh preparation timing/storage are one complete sample, not a reliability or tail-latency estimate
The PID 1 exit hook is compile-time test-only and is absent from the ordinary control guest; it does not qualify production fault injection or physical host suspend.
New fault samples use the consumed-window keeper with new ordinary/test-only initramfs hashes; the original density, materialization and real CLI/TLS-start measurements do not transfer to them.
A zero libkrun helper status is not proof of orderly guest shutdown; the controlled PID 1 panic returned 0 with an actual kernel panic in the console.
Five deterministic stalls execute sync before host SIGKILL; host page cache survives. This is not host power-loss durability or arbitrary instruction/timing coverage.
The classification observes the zlib header, apk package entry and recipe marker. Four final build/dependency hashes match a new reference; this is not full-filesystem equivalence or an audit.
Uninterrupted adaptation/reconstruction rows are retained other-agent runs with byte-identical boot artifacts, kernel, helper, inputs and seed. They were not counted as new repetitions.
Staging storage is now sampled for the fixed Alpine workload fixture; complete environment/companion accounting and a bound on arbitrary transient peaks remain unqualified.

A cooperative stop-receipt prototype now classifies the tested panic/stop cases correctly; production supervisor integration, hostile preparation, other native platforms and physical host suspend remain open.
The host maximum is sampled, with a requested 20-ms interval and actual maximum gaps reported. Sub-interval or unsampled future peaks are not bounded.
Guest statvfs/stat counters cover the entire private filesystem, including test state and workspace; checkpoint differences are not an isolated staging-tree inventory.
Host allocation is stat st_blocks*512 for regular private image/state/controller files, deduplicated by inode. It is not unique APFS extent or snapshot accounting.

Common helpers/kernel/guest/toolchain files, downloaded inputs, private preparation builder, compiler/evidence storage and the proposed companion VM are excluded. No full 8-GiB environment storage pass is inferred.
One synchronized five-point run plus a fresh one-pass reference per adapter; not host power loss, arbitrary mid-write timing, agent/density measurements or a reliability estimate.

The orderly label means a cooperative fixture sync acknowledgement plus owned-child clean exit. It does not establish companion service shutdown/unmount, offline filesystem checks or completed production stop.
A compromised guest can lie about sync; this is not attestation. Failures after a valid acknowledgement and arbitrary timing windows are not qualified by the tested pre-ack panic cases.

The raw libkrun backend still returns zero for both observed panic and poweroff. Only the experimental controller predicate is qualified here; production controller/supervisor integration and journal recovery remain open.
Intent evidence files are fsynced before sending the stop request; host power-loss durability, atomic directory publication and controller restart/replay recovery are not tested.
PID reuse is tested with synthetic native-identity records; real PID reuse is not forced on the host. Old real wire acknowledgements and guest boot-generation refusal are tested natively.
Test private disks/controller directories are retained for diagnostics; active helper and endpoint cleanup is verified. No production resource-retention policy is claimed.
One six-case sample per adapter on native macOS ARM64; other host/architecture rows, host suspend and new-binary density/preparation/agent-start qualification remain outside this proof.
